purpose: Review source layouts whose consecutive-page column borders differ slightly, not financial tolerance or risk thresholds.
geometry: Use the narrowest observed nonmerged cell for each column; a blank merged continuation cell does not define the individual column width.

Adjacent-page continuation requires the same ordered columns, each pair overlapping at least 95 percent of the larger width, outer table edges within one PDF point, a first-row continuation and the preceding last table row.
Preserve all original fragments and independent-reader proofs. Render every accepted continuation boundary; do not infer missing digits from totals or weights.
Source ordinals may use ordinary thousands separators such as 1,000; retain the printed ordinal and require its exact integer value.
nav_note: The original NAV label is split across two adjacent financial-summary rows. Combine only the label fragments and preserve all three printed annual amounts and current-year column evidence.
